title: IEV2Mol: Molecular Generative Model Considering Protein-Ligand Interaction Energy Vectors
authors: Mami Ozawa; NOBUAKI YASUO; Masakazu Sekijima
one_liner_zh: 该研究提出基于蛋白-配体相互作用能量向量的分子生成模型IEV2Mol，虽涉及AI生成与相互作用建模，但对象为小分子配体而非无序蛋白/IDR，且无PPI或相分离背景，仅部分方法思路可迁移。
abstract: Generating drug candidates with desired protein‒ligand interactions is a significant challenge in structure-based drug design. In this study, a new generative model, IEV2Mol, is proposed that incorporates interaction energy vectors (IEVs) between proteins and ligands obtained from docking simulations, which quantitatively capture the strength of each interaction type, such as hydrogen bonds, electrostatic interactions, and van der Waals forces. By integrating this IEV into an end-to-end variational autoencoder (VAE) framework that learns the chemical space from SMILES and minimizes the reconstruction error of the SMILES, the model can more accurately generate compounds with the desired interactions. To evaluate the effectiveness of IEV2Mol, we performed benchmark comparisons with randomly selected compounds, unconstrained VAE models (JT-VAE), and compounds generated by RNN models based on interaction fingerprints (IFP-RNN). The results show that the compounds generated by IEV2Mol retain a significantly greater percentage of the binding mode of the query structure than those of the other methods. Furthermore, IEV2Mol was able to generate compounds with interactions similar to those of the input compounds, regardless of structural similarity. The source code and trained models for IEV2Mol, JT-VAE, and IFP-RNN designed for generating compounds active against the DRD2 receptor, as well as the datasets (DM-QP-1M, DRD2 Active, and ChEMBL33) utilized in this study, are released under the MIT License and available at https://github.com/sekijima-lab/IEV2Mol.
abstract_zh: 在基于结构的药物设计中，生成具有所需蛋白质-配体相互作用的药物候选物是一项重大挑战。本研究提出了一种新的生成模型IEV2Mol，该模型整合了从对接模拟中获得的蛋白质与配体之间的相互作用能量向量（IEVs），这些向量定量捕捉了每种相互作用类型的强度，如氢键、静电相互作用和范德华力。通过将此IEV集成到一个端到端的变分自编码器（VAE）框架中，该框架从SMILES学习化学空间并最小化SMILES的重构误差，模型能够更准确地生成具有所需相互作用的化合物。为评估IEV2Mol的有效性，我们与随机选择的化合物、无约束VAE模型（JT-VAE）以及基于相互作用指纹的RNN模型（IFP-RNN）生成的化合物进行了基准比较。结果表明，IEV2Mol生成的化合物保留了查询结构结合模式的比例显著高于其他方法。此外，IEV2Mol能够生成与输入化合物具有相似相互作用的化合物，无论结构相似性如何。IEV2Mol、JT-VAE和IFP-RNN的源代码及训练模型，以及本研究使用的数据集（DM-QP-1M、DRD2 Active和ChEMBL33），均在MIT许可下发布，并可在https://github.com/sekijima-lab/IEV2Mol获取。
